newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Asian Metals-S.Korean zinc prices fall slightly.
newsitem.headline: Asian Metals-S.Korean zinc prices fall slightly.

text.p: Domestic selling prices for zinc rose slightly in South Korea in line with a gain on the London Metal Exchange (LME) but other metal prices remained flat, traders said on Thursday.
A Tong Yang Global trader said the zinc price increased to 1.26/1.27 million won per tonne this week from 1.25 million won per tonne last week.
He said declining world zinc inventories and short-covering by U.S. companies have pushed zinc prices recently.
But zinc import premiums for spot delivery fell to below $20 over LME spot price on consolidation, he added.
